findings.summary: The Swedish right-triangle formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The formulas used opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse instead of Swedish side terminology.
findings.resolution: Localized all three side labels in the formulas.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expressions contained opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Localized the side labels while preserving inverse-function notation.

findings.summary: The series-cell formula retained the English word series in a Swedish annotation.
The parallel-branch voltage formula retained an English annotation.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (parallel branches).

findings.summary: The yard conversion retained the English unit name.
evidence: The previous formula was 1 yard = 3 fot = 0,9144 m.
findings.resolution: Kept the standard Swedish yard term and corrected the mixed formula wording to the intended localized form.

findings.summary: The right-triangle section mixed Swedish prose with English formula terminology.
evidence: The paragraph defined Swedish side terms while the displayed formulas retained English labels.
findings.resolution: Aligned all displayed ratios with the Swedish explanation.

findings.summary: The angle-finding section was inconsistent across inverse formulas and the surrounding Swedish prose.
evidence: The inverse formulas did not reuse the Swedish side terminology from the preceding explanation.
findings.resolution: Applied one consistent Swedish terminology set throughout the section.

findings.summary: The imperial-length formula mixed English and Swedish naming.
evidence: The yard formula combined an English yard label with Swedish fot.
findings.resolution: Normalized the formula to consistent Swedish unit naming.

findings.summary: The parallel-branch annotation was the remaining English label in the circuit formulas.
evidence: The surrounding Swedish voltage-law section used Swedish terminology while this annotation remained English.
findings.resolution: Changed the annotation to parallellkopplade grenar.
